about_the_game:
About the Game

AsTroops is a roguelike arcade card game set in a world under siege by a massive alien mothership and its ruthless army. You are humanity’s last hope.

Pilot your rocket in real-time, action-packed missions. Navigate deadly areas full of alien ships, lock on to targets, and crash into them to explode. Every mission is unique and requires quick reflexes and smart decisions.

But the battle doesn’t end with the rocket. Between missions, earn money through your idle economy. Invest in science to unlock and upgrade new cards in the research lab — machine guns, rocket launchers, laser cannons, and support cards await you.

Rebuild your deck from scratch with cards of your choice. Customize their functions and abilities to match your playstyle — the choice is yours.

Your mission is clear: weaken the alien mothership’s control by destroying satellites. Every victory makes you stronger; every defeat teaches you a lesson.

AsTroops combines real-time action, idle strategy, and card-based gameplay into a fast-paced space combat experience. How long can you last? Can you break the blockade?

name: Astroops

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 / 8 / 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Runs on low-end systems. For stable 30+ FPS during intense enemy waves, the listed specs are recommended.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 / AMD Radeon R7 250 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Recommended for smooth 60+ FPS at higher resolutions and with visual effects enabled.

short_description: Astroops is a roglike arcade card game where you pilot rockets to break an alien siege. Upgrade your cards, customize your deck, manage an idle economy, unlock tech upgrades, and crash into enemy forces. Destroy waves of evolving alien threats and liberate Earth
